}}'''Noane Masadim''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|950}}.

==History==
Noane held the position for twenty-three years until her death in {{Ne|973}}. She was [[Kirin Melway]]'s successor and [[Tamra Ospenya]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Noane was a weak Amyrlin although not as weak as her predecessor Kirin, but like her she managed to pave the way for a stronger one to follow her.
